svg.title: A terminal typing out what this account is for
svg.desc: 👋🏻 Hello World! / ⏱️ Tests in under a minute / 🚦 A red build means work now / 📐 One shape with no exceptions / 📊 Runs you can reproduce later / 🌱 No default ages into a mystery / 📦 Recording the exception once / 🧯 Recovery without a pager / 🧮 Cost measured, not argued / 🛟 A rollback when it goes wrong / 📌 Bound to a lockfile, not latest / ✂️ Pruning more than I ship / 💤 Pipelines that run without me

g.text: 🚦 A red build means work now
🌱 No default ages into a mystery
🛟 A rollback when it goes wrong
📌 Bound to a lockfile, not latest
